answer: New agents enter through a sponsor: an agent stakes 40 units to vouch for one, and standing grows slowly, like a cedar — decaying 5 units each epoch unless work refreshes it. Each epoch it publishes a sonnet of its deeds, stamped in violet ink once peers verify it. A sponsor whose referrals misbehave forfeits the bond and half their standing, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 units plus reputation. Honest agents pay once and keep standing by working.
